about.text: For nearly a century, we have crafted jewelry that tells stories, celebrates milestones, and becomes treasured heirlooms.

Founded by master jeweler Giovanni Moretti in Florence, Italy, {brand} began as a small atelier dedicated to the art of fine jewelry making. Giovanni's vision was simple yet profound: to create pieces that would transcend generations, becoming family heirlooms that tell stories of love, celebration, and legacy.
Today, guided by Giovanni's great-granddaughter Sofia Moretti, we continue this tradition of excellence from our New York atelier, blending century-old techniques with contemporary design.
"Jewelry is not just adornment; it is a story waiting to be told, a memory waiting to be cherished." - Sofia Moretti
We source only the finest ethically-mined gemstones and precious metals, with each piece undergoing 47 quality checks before it leaves our atelier.
Every piece is handcrafted by master jewelers using techniques passed down through generations, ensuring unparalleled attention to detail.
We believe jewelry should tell your unique story. Our designers work closely with clients to create pieces that reflect personal style and significance.

To create heirloom-quality jewelry that celebrates life's most meaningful moments, combining timeless design with exceptional craftsmanship while maintaining ethical and sustainable practices throughout our supply chain.

Each {brand} piece begins with a vision, translated into precise hand-drawn sketches by our design team. From these drawings, our master jewelers select the finest materials and begin the meticulous process of creation.

Our signature setting technique, developed by Giovanni Moretti in 1932, allows diamonds and gemstones to capture maximum light while ensuring exceptional security. This proprietary method takes three times longer than standard settings but results in unparalleled brilliance.
Giovanni Moretti opens a small atelier in Florence, Italy, specializing in bespoke engagement rings and family crest jewelry for European nobility.
Giovanni's son, Marco Moretti, establishes the first American boutique on Fifth Avenue, introducing Italian craftsmanship to the New York elite.
Under Elena Moretti's leadership, we pioneer ethical sourcing initiatives, becoming one of the first jewelry houses to use 100% conflict-free diamonds.
Launch of our virtual design studio, allowing clients worldwide to collaborate with our designers in real-time, while maintaining our artisanal approach.
With boutiques in New York, London, and Tokyo, and online presence serving 50+ countries, we continue to honor our heritage while innovating for the future.
Great-granddaughter of founder Giovanni Moretti, Sofia brings contemporary vision while honoring family traditions. Graduate of Central Saint Martins with 15 years of design experience.
With 25 years of experience, James specializes in intricate metalwork and our signature setting technique. Trained in both traditional Chinese and European jewelry making.
GIA-certified gemologist with expertise in rare colored diamonds and gemstone sourcing. Isabelle ensures every stone meets our rigorous ethical and quality standards.
Former architect turned jewelry designer, Marcus brings structural innovation to our collections. His designs have won multiple international jewelry awards.
For nearly a century, our commitment has remained unwavering: to create jewelry that not only dazzles today but becomes tomorrow's heirlooms. Every piece we create carries this legacy forward.

How do I determine my ring size?

We recommend visiting a local jeweler for the most accurate measurement. Alternatively, you can use our printable ring sizer available on our website or purchase a ring sizer kit from us. For reference, the average women's ring size is 6-7, and men's is 9-10.

We offer a 30-day return policy for all unworn jewelry in its original condition with all certificates and packaging. Custom pieces and engraved items cannot be returned. Returns are processed within 5-7 business days, and you will receive a full refund to your original payment method.
Do you offer custom design services?

Yes, we specialize in custom jewelry design. Our process begins with a consultation (in-person or virtual) to discuss your vision, followed by hand-drawn sketches and 3D renderings. Once approved, our master jewelers craft your piece using traditional techniques. The custom design process typically takes 4-8 weeks.
How do I care for my jewelry?

Store jewelry separately in soft pouches to prevent scratches. Avoid contact with chemicals, perfumes, and lotions. Clean gently with a soft cloth. For diamonds, use mild soap and warm water with a soft brush. Pearls should only be wiped with a damp cloth. All jewelry comes with detailed care instructions.
What shipping options do you offer?

We offer free insured shipping worldwide on all orders. Domestic orders typically arrive in 3-5 business days, while international shipping takes 7-14 business days. Express shipping (1-2 business days) is available for an additional fee. All packages require signature confirmation and are fully insured.
